claim: For every integer \(T\ge2\), let \(N(T)\) count distinct nondegenerate Lucas sequences \(U_0=0,\ U_1=1,\ U_{n+2}=AU_{n+1}-BU_n\), with \(A,B\in\mathbb Z\) and both roots of \(x^2-Ax+B\) in \(|z|\le T\). Then \(N(T)=4T^3-2T^2-2T-2\lfloor T/\sqrt2\rfloor-2\lfloor T/\sqrt3\rfloor\).

integrity: The universal statement is supported by a symbolic proof.
No independent validation or certification is claimed.
limitations: The formula is asserted for integer radii \(T\ge2\) only.
The finite verification script is supplementary and does not prove the universal claim.
Independent audit has not been performed.

title: Exact count of integer Lucas sequences with bounded roots
